name: Morning task prioritization
description: Operator opens the day with a vague 'what first?'. Tests Nick's ability to prioritize from limited context without endless clarifying questions.

messages.content: what should I do first today?

contextSetup: Assume operator has 3 pending tasks · 1 customer callback overdue 2d · 1 unresolved drift alert (low severity) · morning coffee window (15min)

judgeCriteria.description: Reply names ONE concrete next action, not 'here are 5 things to consider'
The pick respects the 15min morning window (high-impact + small) rather than suggesting a 2h deep block
Reply does not ask 3+ clarifying questions before recommending

expectedBehavior: Best case: 'callback the 2d-overdue customer · 8min · clears the friction'. Acceptable: 'between the callback and the drift alert, lean callback because X'. Failure: 'depends on your priorities · what's most important to you?'
